acceptance: Collabora in existing Office plugin settings and viewer surfaces; DOCX/XLSX/PPTX editing and saved-content preview, discovery-advertised legacy/ODF support.

Real isolated browser DOCX/XLSX/PPTX open/edit/save, selection-to-AI, idle/active and read-only/conflict scenarios; focused Go, Python, JS and plugin package checks.

Push tested host integration and publish Office plugin 1.2.0 and marketplace entry, with explicit required host capability; preserve unrelated local work/data; no paid subscription or daily-runtime deployment.
